description: Abwasserbeitragsermittlung_GVV_EDIT is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The determination of the sewage contribution of the GVV Mittleren Kochertal is used for the calculation and determination of sewage contributions for land. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater contribution assessment _GVV _EDIT" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include GVV, neu veranlagte Fläche, Fläche gestundet, Niedernhall, Abwasserbeitragsermittlung, Weißbach. The listing shows 2025-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
